नैश a. (शी f.), नैशिक a. (की f.)
1 Nocturnal, belonging to the night,
nightly; तन्नैशं तिमिरमपाकरोति चंद्रः
Ś. 6. 29; नैशस्यार्चिर्हुतभुज इव
छिन्नभूयिष्ठधूमा

1 A king of the Niṣadhas.
--2 Especially, an epithet of king
Nala, q. v.
--3 A native or
inhabitant of Niṣadha.
--4 N. of a
Mahākāvaya by Śrīharṣa, treating of the
adventures of Nala, king of the
Nishadhas.

1 Idleness, inactivity.
--2
Exemption from acts or their
consequences;

.
--3 The
salvation obtained by abstraction
(as opposed to the salvation
obtained by कर्ममार्ग q. v.).

नैष्कशतिक a. (की f.) Worth a
hundred Niṣkas.

नैष्किक a. (की f.) Bought with
or made of a Niṣka, q. v.
--कः A
mint-master.

नैष्किंचन्यं Indigence, absolute
poverty or want.

नैष्क्रमणं Any oblation or rite
performed when a newborn child is
taken out of the house for the first
time.

नैष्ठिक a. (की f.)
1 Final, last,
concluding; विदधे विधिमस्य नैष्ठिकं

.
--2 Decided, definitive,
conclusive (as a reply.).
--3 Fixed,
firm, constant.
--4 Highest, perfect.
--5 Completely familiar with or
versed in.
--6 Vowing perpetual
abstinence and chastity.
--कः [निष्ठा
मरणं तत्पर्यंतं ब्रह्मचर्येण तिष्ठति, निष्ठा-ठक्]
A perpetual religious student who
continues with his spiritual
preceptor even after the prescribed period,
and vows life-long abstinence and
chastity;

नैष्ठ्यं Constancy, steady adherence
to rule, firm belief, steadfastness.

नैसर्गिक a. (की f.) Natural,
inborn, innate, inherent; नैसर्गिकी
सुरभिणः कुसुमस्य सिद्धा मूर्ध्नि स्थितिर्न
मुसलैरवताडनानि
